purpose: Static educational close-view candidate; independent acceptance and publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain irregular scale surfaces, elongated cone and unbranched arms. Concept has a conspicuous deep empty cup and arm count obscured: actual model closes the top with a shallow neutral surface without inventing mouth/anus, and has exactly eight separately readable arms. Plate relief restrained, not thick armored tiles; small soft processes alternate sides.

Small attachment disk and elongated tapering plated conical stalk, widening to short broad cup. Eight unbranched arms around cup edge; each has six alternating small soft projections, with arm gaps preserved. Irregular thin plate/scalelike relief across body, more regular uniserial arm segmentation; no columnals or fivefold branching. Whole animal inferred from fossils, with artistic pose/color and moderate low-poly plate relief. Affinity disputed between echinoderm and cnidarian interpretations; no categorical crinoid assignment, no mouth/anus or stereom modeled. ROM image collection attribution verified; GSC25962 separately verified in Ausich/Babcock1998 textfig1 and plate1. Substrate tube omitted as not part of the animal.
Complete original frozen brief/config/reference/concept preserved; exact dependency closure, counts and real measurements.
Exact GLB successfully parsed through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
